decision_conditions:
The works to which this consent relate shall be begun not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority retains the right to review unimplemented consents and to ensure their long-term future in accordance with Policy LP33 in the Council’s Local Plan.
description:
Extension of means of access to a highway. Replace timber gates with electric metal gates and reposition brick piers. Installation of EV charger. Detached rear outbuilding with a green roof and integrated solar panels. Demolish WC. Single storey rear extension. Repair works to the main property. Window works including repair, replacement and upgrading non-original elements. Landscaping works. (AMENDED PLANS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION) (Summary).

Householder application consent sought under application reference 3456/25.
